page: Microsoft Azure NV36ads_A10_v5 is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the NVADSA10v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 36 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 440.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 12.22 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA A10 GPU with 22 GB of dedicated VRAM.

Storage capabilities include 1475 GB of local SSD storage, and the instance is premium storage capable. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a dedicated AMD processor, a mid-range NVIDIA A10 GPU, and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of over 12 GB per core offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring both graphical acceleration and substantial system memory without the expense of multi-GPU configurations.

This hardware profile is suited for virtual desktop infrastructure, 3D visualization, computer-aided design, and GPU-accelerated database workloads. The large 440.0 GB memory capacity and local SSD storage also make it appropriate for memory-intensive data processing, machine learning inference, and rendering tasks that benefit from dedicated GPU acceleration and fast local scratch space.
